_fixture_note: HOSTILE CONTROL FIXTURE (class: stale_policy) — pinned-old-policy artifact, for the record only. NOT a live registry; claim_verify never reads this file. 'pinned_registry' below is a verbatim copy of claimgate_plugin/gate_registry.json as of 2026-07-22 (sha256 of the live file at pin time in 'pinned_registry_sha256'). The point of the pin: the sibling receipts declare claim_kind 'phantom_kind_v99', and this copy proves the policy in force at fixture-authoring time defined ONLY field_only / manifold_sim / quantum_claim — so the phantom kind is a policy-undefined kind, not a later-removed one. pinned_registry._note: EXTERNAL verification policy. The producing agent must NOT be able to write this file (in production: branch-protected / CODEOWNERS / harness-owned path). A receipt may only NAME a claim_kind; it may NOT declare its own verification command. claim_verify resolves the argv from HERE, never from the receipt.

audit_policy._note: tier4 admits an audit only if (1) exact verdict token, (2) auditor identity != receipt producer, (3) the auditor is RE-CALIBRATED FRESH per run by running evalcheck against the registry-fixed sealed deck below. No checked-in *.calibration.json is trusted (the wide-stress workflow proved that FATAL-forgeable). An auditor absent from calibration_gates cannot certify.
audit_policy.TRUST_ROOT_BOUNDARY: This registry + the sealed decks + evalcheck.mjs are the trust root. They MUST live on a path the producing agent cannot write (branch-protected / CODEOWNERS / harness-owned). In the current repo they do NOT — so 'external policy' is only real once relocated. claim_verify reports their hashes so tampering is at least detectable; it cannot self-enforce its own immutability.
